response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with genuine tooling and developer-experience interests, but the core stack for this role — deep Java/Kotlin expertise, JVM internals, and the Spring ecosystem — is largely absent from his background. His recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js and D, with only incidental Java exposure years ago and no Kotlin or Spring experience. Despite relevant IDE-adjacent experience (LabWindows/CVI at National Instruments, custom test runners and language libraries), the gap on the required qualifications is too large for a mid-senior JVM tooling role.
strengths: Direct IDE development experience (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI)
Strong developer-tooling track record (test runners, assertion libraries, MCP code generators, CI infrastructure)
Broad, long-tenured engineering career with low-latency, high-scale systems experience
concerns: No demonstrable Kotlin experience and only minimal, dated Java exposure
No evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM framework work
Recent focus (TypeScript/Node, D) diverges significantly from the JVM ecosystem required
